extracted.name: Chunky peanut soup
extracted.description: Make this peanut soup for lunch. Nutrient-dense, peanuts are a great source of good-for-you fats, protein and fibre, as well as stress-busting B vitamins
ingredient_lines: 1.2l boiling vegetable stock made with 3 tsp vegetable bouillon
⅓ x 30g pack fresh coriander chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a large pan (it makes a big quantity) and fry the onions and ginger, stirring frequently, for 10 mins until starting to turn golden. Add the garlic and chilli, cook for a few mins more, then stir in the curry powder and cumin seeds.

Pour in the tomatoes and stock, add the peanut butter and tomato purée, then bring to the boil. Stir in the potatoes, squash, chickpeas and cabbage, then cover the pan and leave to simmer for 15 mins until the vegetables are tender. Stir in the fresh coriander, then spoon two portions into two bowls and serve. Cool and chill the remainder to eat another day. Will keep chilled for up to three days.
